resources.string: Each person chosen receives the group\'s key in one transaction from you. Then every message is a single transaction, whatever the group\'s size. Members see the group in this app only, not on the Idena Social website.
Saving hands a new key to the people kept and added. People removed do not get it: they cannot read what is sent with it, and their own messages stop counting. People added read from now on.
Only you see this name, on this phone. Leave it empty to take the group\'s own name back.
Only you see this name, on this phone and in this group. Leave it empty to take their own name back.

Only the group\'s members can read its messages. Who writes and when is public, on the chain for good. The group\'s name and members are not; how many they are shows each time its creator hands out a key.
This conversation is hidden on this phone. Social settings shows it again.
Hidden on this phone only: nobody is told, and new messages still arrive. Writing to someone again shows your conversation with them.
Share it with the people who should be able to write to you: with it they can, even before your first transaction. It holds only your public key, nothing secret.
Your key cannot be read now.
Ask them for their message code (Messages, \"My message code\") and paste it here. You can also paste it in the Messages search.
On this phone only: nobody is told, and new messages still arrive. Social settings › Hidden conversations shows it again.
